g.text: FLASH DRUM VER 1 - OPERATOR TRAINING SIMULATOR
D-400 FLASH DRUM UNIT - FEED PREHEAT, LET-DOWN AND FLASH
Feed 16 m3/h, 35 wt% n-butane / 65 wt% n-hexane
E-400 duty about 420 kW, hot oil 180 -> 120 °C
1. Flows in kg/h; temperatures in °C; pressures in kPa g. Stream data: D-400 design case.
2. P-400 and the hot-oil system are outside the unit; shown as supplies.
3. PSV-400 set 450 kPa g (MAWP). N2 blanket PCV-430 holds 30 kPa g.
